description: This Java source file defines the class OneForOneStreamManager, which manages streams of ManagedBuffer objects, allowing registration, chunk retrieval, and connection cleanup within the Spark network module.

classes.name: OneForOneStreamManager
classes.description: Manages streams of ManagedBuffer objects, allowing registration, chunk retrieval, and cleanup, with support for authorization and transfer tracking.

classes.name: StreamState
classes.description: Represents the state of an individual stream, including its buffers, associated channel, and transfer status.

methods.name: OneForOneStreamManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream ID generator and stream map.

methods.name: getChunk
methods.description: Retrieves a specific chunk from a stream, ensuring order and stream validity.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens a stream based on a stream chunk ID string.

methods.name: genStreamChunkId
methods.description: Generates a string ID for a stream chunk from stream ID and chunk index.

methods.name: parseStreamChunkId
methods.description: Parses a stream chunk ID string into stream ID and chunk index.

methods.name: connectionTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a client connection is terminated, releasing buffers and removing streams.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Verifies client authorization for a specific stream based on app ID.

methods.name: chunkBeingSent
methods.description: Increments the count of chunks being transferred for a stream.

methods.name: streamBeingSent
methods.description: Marks a stream as being sent based on stream ID string.

methods.name: chunkSent
methods.description: Decrements the count of chunks being transferred for a stream.

methods.name: streamSent
methods.description: Marks a stream as sent based on stream ID string.

methods.name: chunksBeingTransferred
methods.description: Returns total number of chunks currently being transferred across all streams.

methods.name: registerStream
methods.description: Registers a new stream with buffers, app ID, channel, and buffer materialization flag.

methods.name: numStreamStates
methods.description: Returns the current number of active stream states.
